_note: Demo catalog for the fictional places (testnet). Keyed by on-chain merchant name. offers[0].price is the on-chain list price; other offers are priced by this catalog and co-signed by the demo desk only for totals the server computes.

Casa Azulejo Nove.note: Nine rooms above the tiled stairs, a courtyard that stays cool in the afternoon.

Pátio do Vento.note: A rooftop above the trams, windy and bright, breakfast on the terrace.

Ribeira Slow House.note: A slow house by the river market. Late breakfast, no rush to leave.

Café Lento.note: A small café that takes its time. Warm nata until ten.

Linho & Sal.note: Linen goods made in Portugal, cut and sewn in the back room.

Alfama Sleep Rooms.note: Simple rooms on a steep lane, a window onto the river.

Graça Hill Hostel.note: Private rooms for hostel money, a view of the castle from the kitchen.

Belém Garden Inn.note: A garden breakfast five minutes from the monastery. Bikes to borrow.

offers.title: family room
offers.sub: two beds, one cot on request

Chiado Townhouse.note: High ceilings, real books, the opera house around the corner.

offers.title: attic suite
offers.sub: roof windows, a bath under the eaves

Torra Coffee Lab.note: A roastery with six stools. They weigh every shot.

Pastelaria Nove.note: A neighbourhood pastelaria. Custard tarts warm at eight.

Tasca do Rio.note: No menu. The owner tells you what came in this morning.

offers.title: dinner for one
offers.sub: grilled fish of the day, salad, wine

Mesa Atlântica.note: Atlantic seafood, slow cooking, worth the wait for the octopus rice.

Peixe & Brasa.note: Pick your fish from the counter, it goes straight on the coals.

Azul Print Studio.note: Screen prints of the city on heavy cotton.
